svg.text: VP&C Agent Marketplace - Data flow and trust boundaries
Every arrow that crosses a dashed boundary is numbered. The table lists what travels on it. Full DPIA detail is in section 7 of the HLD.
No marketplace data is stored on
Terminates identity before app code runs
Stateless. Holds no durable copy of any record
300s TTL. Catalogue only, never personal data.
The marketplace sends no record from B3 to B4. The
Concierge payload is the user's typed task plus
Third party and internal, each with its own approval
Covered by the Emplay portfolio entry
The marketplace hands the user over. It does not proxy the
conversation and does not retain it.
Signed JWT with the verified email
One vote per person per agent
Let the owner decide on access
Task description typed by the user, plus catalogue text
As flow 7, inside the Vodafone boundary
Hand the user to the real agent
Exclusion that bounds the whole assessment
No supplier record, contract, purchase order, invoice, price or spend figure is read, stored or transmitted by this application at any point. The marketplace describes
agents; it does not operate them. That boundary is what keeps its data classification low and is the single most important statement in this assessment.
Where the residual privacy risk sits
Flow 5 is the only place a free-text field is stored against an identified person, and flow 7 is the only place free text leaves the application tier. Both are
called out in the DPIA. Everything else is either pseudonymous or carries no personal data at all.
